description: This Java class defines the response for a DeletePolicy command within the Eclipse Ditto framework, encapsulating response metadata and the PolicyId of the deleted policy, along with JSON serialization/deserialization logic.

classes.name: DeletePolicyResponse
classes.description: Final immutable class representing the response to a delete policy command, including JSON (de)serialization, entity identification, and response metadata.

methods.name: getEntityId
